subject: CardinalCloud CIO pre-brief & sponsor demo coordination
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@cardinalcloud.com>, Bob Mitchell <bob.mitchell@cardinalcloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + quick sponsor pre-brief for CardinalCloud pilot

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a short sponsor pre-brief ahead of the demo so your CIO (and any VP-level sponsors) have context on the scope and success criteria. Goal is a focused 20–30 minute sync: 

- Confirm CIO priorities (security, latency targets, data residency)
- Walk through the demo agenda and timeboxes
- Agree on attendees and follow-up actions / M.A.P.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Nov 18, 9:00–9:30am
- Tue Nov 18, 3:00–3:30pm
- Wed Nov 19, 10:00–10:30am

Attached a draft agenda for the pre-brief (draft-demo-agenda.docx). If one of these works, I will send a calendar hold and pull in our CTO liaison and Karthik from pre-sales. If the CIO prefers a brief technical readout instead, please note and we can adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: draft-demo-agenda.docx (agenda outline)

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@cardinalcloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Bob Mitchell <bob.mitchell@cardinalcloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + quick sponsor pre-brief for CardinalCloud pilot

Rafael —

Thanks for the options. The CIO is out Monday but available Nov 18 at 3pm PT for a 25-minute pre-brief. He asked that the session cover:

- High-level security posture and data flows (5m)
- Demo scope and expected outcomes (10m)
- Post-demo success metrics and next steps (5m)

Also, can you send the SOC 2 summary and any short readouts for encryption at rest / network isolation? If those are in order, he will attend for ~20–25 minutes.

Please schedule 3:00–3:25pm PT on Nov 18 and include a calendar note with the live demo window on Nov 25.

Appreciate it —
Alice Chen
Director of Cloud Strategy | CardinalCloud
alice.chen@cardinalcloud.com

Alice / Bob —

Thanks for confirming. Calendar invite sent for Nov 18, 3:00–3:25pm PT (please accept). I've attached the short SOC 2 summary and the demo deck extract that maps to the CIO view. Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, rdw-demo-deck-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan-CC.xlsx.

Agenda (20–25m):
- 3:00–3:05: Quick intros and CIO priorities (Rafael)
- 3:05–3:12: Security & data flow overview (Karthik)
- 3:12–3:18: Demo scope & success metrics (Vanessa)
- 3:18–3:23: Agree ask list and next steps (Rafael)

Note: Live demo scheduled for Nov 25; we will reserve an hour for internal technical deep-dive the same day. If the CIO prefers a different attendee list (VP of SecOps instead of CIO), please flag and we will adjust invites.

Best,
Rafael

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, rdw-demo-deck-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan-CC.xlsx
